summary: RADCOM filed a 6-K reporting the resignation of five directors (Andre Fuetsch, Rami Schwartz, Rachel Bennun, Oren Most, Yaron Ravkaie) effective May 18-19, 2026, with no disagreements cited. The resignations precede an Extraordinary General Meeting on May 20, 2026, for election of new directors. The filing also includes Q1 2026 financial results with 12% revenue growth to $18.6M, non-GAAP EPS of $0.28, and reaffirmed 8-12% full-year revenue guidance. The event is a board change, but the bulk resignation aligned with a planned meeting suggests a scheduled refresh rather than an abrupt departure. Watch for shareholder approval of new director nominees.
